accessibility.accessibleNameSource: None. Card has no role, so it is not a landmark or a named region; the title is a visual heading. For a heading in the document outline, put a real heading element inside sb-card-title.
aria: no roles or ARIA on any card element: content keeps its own semantics
accessibility.targetSize: Card itself is not interactive; controls placed in it follow their own components.

antiPatterns.alternative: Separator or Item inside one card
antiPatterns.why: Stacked borders and shadows flatten the hierarchy and waste space

antiPatterns.pattern: Using a card as the only way to group a whole page
antiPatterns.why: A page-wide card adds a border without grouping anything

A dense list of cards or a sidebar panel

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.notes: The host is the card surface (border, radius, shadow); its parts are child elements in the default slot.

default.notes: sb-card-header, sb-card-content and sb-card-footer, in reading order.
sb-card-title, sb-card-description and an optional sb-card-action.

elements.summary: Groups title, description and an optional action. A sb-card-action child moves the action to the end of the header.
Supporting text under the title, in muted color.
An action (button, menu trigger) placed at the end of the header, spanning title and description.
The card's main content, inset like the header.

default.notes: Actions or text, laid out in a row.

openQuestions.question: How does the header know it has an action, without sibling selectors across shadow roots?
openQuestions.recommendation: sb-card-header listens to slotchange and sets data-has-action on itself; CSS keys off that attribute.

openQuestions.question: Optional header and footer borders?
openQuestions.recommendation: Not in v1: no class hooks in Web Components; add boolean props when a use case appears.

contract.summary: A surface that groups related content and actions: header, title, description, action, content and footer (a family of Web Components).

# Plan: Card (planning gate)

Status: Approved under SB-0011 (owner pre-approval, 2026-11-08).

## Scope
`sb-card` and six parts (`sb-card-header`, `-title`, `-description`, `-action`, `-content`, `-footer`) with `size` medium|small. Non-interactive surface.

## Files (in build order)
| Step | File |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | `src/components/card/Card.stories.ts` |
| 2 | `playwright/tests/card/card.behavior.spec.ts` (written first, must fail) |
| 3 | `src/components/card/Card.scss` -> `Card.styles.ts` (generated, shared by all parts) |
| 4 | `Card.ts`, `CardHeader.ts`, `CardTitle.ts`, `CardDescription.ts`, `CardAction.ts`, `CardContent.ts`, `CardFooter.ts`, `index.ts` |

## Tokens
Component tokens `card.*` alias semantic tokens. Added semantic tokens: `space.stack.*`, `font.size.heading`, `font.weight.heading`, `font.line-height.heading` (shared with the other Wave 1b components).

## Test plan (test-first)
- Surface: border, radius, padding, gap and colors resolve from tokens in light and dark.
- `size=small` changes padding, gap and the inset of header, content and footer.
- Header: `data-has-action` appears and disappears as an action is added or removed; with an action, the action sits at the end and title and description stay at the start.
- Title and description typography.
- No roles anywhere; all seven tags are registered; axe clean on the default and action stories.

## Accessibility deviations from the references
None.

## Open questions
- Q1 Header action detection: answered, host attribute from `slotchange`.
- Q2 Header and footer borders: answered, out of scope for v1.
